usedFor: Jibble tracks attendance, and Portfolio Manager records an event when “New Clock In” runs “Create an Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Clock In” in Jibble, then “Create an Event” in Portfolio Manager
bestTemplate.why: Each clock in shows up as an event in the project workspace, with owner and dates.

watchOut: “New Clock In” in Jibble is polling, so the event appears after the next scheduled check.
